title: Dispatch ledger row (v1)
description: Append-only JSONL, exactly one row per dispatch attempt including crashed attempts (DS-6). Single writer: the dispatch engine, appends serialized under an exclusive file lock (DS-5). Every field script-derived from run outputs — no hand-written prose fields (INV-3). Readers: scripts/report.py, audit/calibration analysis.

unit.description: Unit id; mutant dispatches use mut:<ac_id>:<n> (consumed by report.py per-AC aggregation).

tier.description: Tier name from the configured ordered tier list.

model_id.description: Concrete model id resolved from the tier list; null on a crash before resolution is impossible (resolution precedes spawn, so normally set).

budget.description: Per-unit budget fuse (USD) for this attempt.

cost_usd.description: Billed cost from worker output; null when the worker died before emitting a parsable figure (DS-6 permits a best-known partial figure where a harness provides one; THIS engine records null — no recovery path exists for an unparsable output).

terminal_reason.description: Precedence when multiple apply in one attempt: budget_exhausted > error > completed (DS-4).

verdict.description: Held-out check verdict; NONE when the check could not run (crash).

escalated_from.description: Previous attempt number this attempt escalates from; null on a first attempt. Chain must follow the configured tier order, no skips (AC-8/AC-9).

sha256.description: sha256 of the rendered contract at dispatch time (audit chain: row -> contract -> transcript -> diff -> check).

inputs_rev.description: Freeze-manifest sha the render consumed (expansion records + interface artifact).

check.description: Path to the held-out check output.

session_id.description: Worker session id for transcript-level audit.

worker_refusal.description: Optional; engine-derived: true when the worker report matches the refusal patterns (DS-14). Data feed for the deferred interface-feedback loop (risk-2).

interface_revision_ref.description: Optional; pointer to an interface-artifact revision this attempt provoked (DS-14).

check_cost_usd.description: Additive optional field: cost of running the held-out check for this attempt (0 for local rulers). Lets report.py split generation cost vs run cost per mutant from ledger rows alone (DS-11/AC-12).
